prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One original SUN IDOL for a heroic hand-painted tabletop temple. A tall stout ivory stone column on a small square foot carries a large solid golden sunburst disk, its expressive round sun face angled upward toward the elevated viewer. Eight short thick triangular golden rays join directly to the solid round face disk, no gaps or spokes, no wheel rim. The golden SUN is the dominant silhouette, twice the column width. Dimensions 42 inches wide, 30 deep, 84 tall. Broad bevels, thick sturdy parts, matte painted gradients, restrained texture, ivory and warm yellow gold. Three-quarter view looking down 40 degrees, whole object isolated with generous margins on transparent background. No throne, no seat, no wheel, no arch, no thin rods, no text, no other objects, no floor or cast shadow. Original text-only design, no named deity or published product.
